feedback: The geometry with wheel track 0.18 and rear sensors moved back to y=-0.035 helped by providing earlier line detection, which should allow the controller to anticipate sharp turns better. However, the previous controller had to compensate for persistent early off-track failures and one line loss event per run, indicating the need for more aggressive and responsive control. The wider wheel track continues to provide good lateral stability, reducing off-track risk. The rear sensors' increased backward offset is promising but requires stronger controller gains and sensor weights to fully exploit the earlier line information.
requested_changes: controller.base_speed to 0.155 to increase speed and progress
controller.kp to 0.23, ki to 0.03, kd to 0.05 for more responsive and precise control
controller.sensor_weights for rear sensors (indices 5 and 6) to -0.25 to enhance corrective steering from earlier line detection
